gaps.reason: A suppression record marks the declaration it binds live, which withholds the finding a liveness relation would have produced for it, and this kind reports a declaration the analysis already holds live, so a record naming the code withholds nothing and is reported as a stale suppression instead. Narrow the declaration the finding names, or set the severity of the code to allow.
